name: superset-agent-orchestrator
description: Local-first MCP server for durable orchestration of parallel coding agents through Superset

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:python && npm run corpus:check && npm run schema:check && npm run provenance:verify && npm run research:verify
scripts.format: prettier --write '.github/**/*.yml' README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md EVAL_CONTRACT.md docs/branch-protection.md docs/prior-art.md docs/licensing.md docs/public-readiness.md docs/setup-and-troubleshooting.md config/disklm-eval-contract.json eslint.config.js package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json scripts/disklm-contract.mjs scripts/verify-disklm-research.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check '.github/**/*.yml' README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md EVAL_CONTRACT.md docs/branch-protection.md docs/prior-art.md docs/licensing.md docs/public-readiness.md docs/setup-and-troubleshooting.md config/disklm-eval-contract.json eslint.config.js package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json scripts/disklm-contract.mjs scripts/verify-disklm-research.mjs
scripts.schema:check: npm run schema && git diff --exit-code -- config/mcp-tools.schema.json
scripts.load:ci: npm run build && node dist/src/bounded-load-ci.js artifacts/per-351-ci
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && c8 --all --check-coverage --branches=88 --functions=92 --lines=95 --statements=95 --include=src/store.ts --include=src/storage.ts --include=src/fake-agent-adapter.ts --include=src/tool-contract.ts --reporter=text --reporter=json-summary npm test
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:race
